text:
devon: Heads-up: eu-west g-pool-03 (~g-pool-eu-3) reporting driver restarts and pod evictions. Queue backlog spiking to ~2.4k. Autoscaler not adding nodes. Opening incident.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-118 created: eu-west GPU pool instability. Severity: high. Pager duty: infra-oncall.

maria: Noted. p99 inference latency in eu-west jumped 85ms -> 650ms. Frontend falling back to na-west but we're seeing a ~40% increase in cross-region egress plus tail latency.

liam: Any noisy tenants or long-running batches? Can we get top memory consumers in the pool?

liam: ```bash
kubectl -n ml get pods -o json | jq -r '.items[] | [.metadata.name, (.spec.containers[].resources.requests.memory // "-" )] | @tsv' | sort -k2 -r | head
```

devon: Found 2 long-running batch jobs from customer 'atlas' holding KV-cache pinned and preventing shard eviction. Killing atlas-batch-9 freed GPU kernels and reduced contention.

ops-pager: applied kill to atlas-batch-9 at 12:18 UTC, freed 8 GPUs.

maria: Good call. Rather than full evacuation, propose a soft GSLB ramp + session-cookie drain to avoid cache thrash and cold-start costs.

liam: Proposed ramp plan and router flags:
```bash
# soft-ramp eu-west weights to avoid abrupt cache invalidation
gslbctl update --region eu-west --weight 0.6 --ttl 120
sleep 600
gslbctl update --region eu-west --weight 0.3 --ttl 120
sleep 600
gslbctl update --region eu-west --weight 0.1 --ttl 120
# enable router session cookie drain to let existing sessions finish
routerctl set-affinity --region eu-west --cookie drain=true
```

maria: Applying first step now: eu-west -> 0.6, ttl=120. Also setting manual route override for customer alpha to pin to na-west to protect SLA.

maria: /routes/alpha override -> na-west (manual)

devon: Note: pinning alpha will push them to dedicated capacity in na-west; expect a billing/egress bump ~+9-12% this hour. Approve?

maria: Confirmed. Alpha is high-priority; do it.

liam: Monitoring infra dashboards and p95/p99. If evictions continue, we escalate to full evacuation + spin up spare dedicated pool in eu-south. That has longer lead time (~20m to boot & attach).

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-118 updated: status=mitigating, responders=[devon,maria,liam].

maria: eu-west driver restarts dropping, eviction rate down to 12/min (was ~40/min). Keeping weight at 0.6 for next 10m then ramp to 0.3.

devon: Quick cost note for postmortem: soft-ramp + selective pinning strategy trades immediate latency stability for short-term egress/dedicated spend. Estimate +12% hourly spend while pins active.

maria: Dashboard/console link: https://console.redwood.internal/infra/incident/INC-2026-118

liam: If stable after 30m we revert alpha override and progressively restore eu-west weight to baseline. If not, plan evacuation and create capacity in eu-south.

devon: Scheduling postmortem: tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

maria: Will follow up with timeline and rollback playbook in the incident doc.

ops-pager: Monitoring alarms greening but still under watch.

maria: Closing updates for now — continuing monitoring and will update if anything changes.
